examples.arabic: بابا قال: إحنا لازم نروح السوق النهاردة يا حلوين.
examples.english: Dad said: We must go to the market today, my dears.
examples.transliteration: Baba aal: Ehna lazam narouh el soo2 ennaharda ya helwein.

examples.arabic: ماما جابت ملوخية خضرا من السوق.
examples.english: Mom brought green molokhia from the market.
examples.transliteration: Mama gabt molokheya khadra men el sou2.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

examples.arabic: بكرة هنروح أنا وأختي السوق علشان نشتري فاكهة طازة، ممكن نجيب أربع برتقالات كبار.
examples.english: Tomorrow, my sister and I will go to the market to buy fresh fruit; we might get four big oranges.
examples.transliteration: Bokra hanrooḥ ana we ʾokhty el sooʾ ʾalashan neshtry fakha taza, momken nigeeb ʾarbaʾ bortoqalat kobar.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Morning: Coffee, Music, and the Market

examples.arabic: أحمد راح السوق الكبير في القاهرة امبارح.
examples.english: Ahmed went to the big market in Cairo yesterday.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed rah el sooq el kebir fel Qahera embareh.

examples.arabic: هو لقى خمس عربيات جنب السوق واختار الأقوى.
examples.english: He found five carts near the market and chose the strongest one.
examples.transliteration: Howa la-aa khamas arabiyat ganb el-souq wa ekhtar el-aqwa.

examples.english: I go to the big market today
examples.transliteration: ana baroh el soo el kabeer el naharda
